review_pass_1.findings: Checked scope against both official CSIR documents and reproduced SET syllabus; verified selected textbook, primary record and review evidence on cortical rotation, maternal beta-catenin, VegT, Nieuwkoop center, Nodal-related induction, Spemann–Mangold donor and host contributions, Chordin/BMP binding, anterior identity and neural induction. Explicitly distinguished marker from function, maternal and later Wnt activities, organizer from Nieuwkoop center, and hypothetical data from primary observations. Recomputed arc, fluorescence ratio, defect frequency difference, kinetic ratio, equilibrium free ligand, exponential boundary and diffusion scaling.

review_pass_2.findings: Reordered 21 sections into prerequisite, evidence, mechanism, regional pattern, experimental and quantitative progression; corrected graph label and yolk label; added source links and two datasets, integrated revision and checklist; checked 54 question keys with balanced positions and distractor explanations; compared 5.B.07 13,852 lexical teaching words, exact paragraph overlap zero. Parsed script and checked static IDs, anchors, ARIA and figure controls.
